name: Notifications
purpose: Communicate system status and feedback to the user. RAG-coded family in four placements: Contextual (attached to a field/section, incl. a form multi-link variant), Global (page-level banner), Inline (compact inline message), and Snackbar (transient toast). Each carries the standard variants error / warning / success / information (Snackbar omits error).
$family: Covers the 'Notifications' canvas: Contextual, Global, Inline, Snackbar.
$stateModel-note: The banner is a status message; its interactive affordances (action links, dismiss ×) have only default/hover/pressed/focus — no selected/checked/disabled. Declared simple so the scorer credits states for that applicable set (rubric Decision C, 2026-06-24).

props.name: variant
props.$note: RAG status. Snackbar = warning/success/information only (no error).

props.name: multiLink
props.$note: Contextual 'form multi-link' variant with action links.

variants.name: contextual
variants.use: Attached to a form field or section; tinted surface + RAG accent. Includes a multi-link form variant.

variants.name: global
variants.use: Page-level banner; solid RAG fill with reverse text/icon (rag/text/on-dark|on-light). Responsive scale 3/4/5.

variants.name: inline
variants.use: Compact single-line inline message (RAG icon + text).

variants.name: snackbar
variants.use: Transient toast with elevation/functional shadow; warning/success/information.

tokens.text: text/default #333 @ font-5 medium (title) / light (body); global uses rag/text/on-light #333 & rag/text/on-dark #fff
tokens.spacing: gap/responsive/content/small 8, padding/responsive medium 16 / xsmall 11 / xxsmall 9 / fixed small 12
tokens.$finding: (2026-06-20) rag/warning accent (#FFBB33) is ~1.6:1 on its warning-tint — the icon SHAPE + text carry meaning (1.4.1); accent not gated as a contrast pair. Tints reconciled, text legible on all four both modes.

responsive.rule: All placements are fluid (max-width:100%). Global's Action 1 / Action 2 row stacks below the message on a narrow container; contextual/inline/snackbar wrap their text. Verified to 320px / WCAG 1.4.10, 0 horizontal overflow, both themes.

motion.dismiss: Dismiss × is tactile (hover scale 1.2 / press 1.08); dismissing collapses the banner height + fades (~0.3s) so the stack reflows. Reduced-motion neutralises the transforms; the collapse remains (layout).

$rebuild-2026-06-24: Rebuilt to the full Figma family (node 45002-355009): Contextual (compact + form multi-link), Global (solid fill, reverse text/icon, Action 1/2; warning uses dark text #333), Inline (bare icon + message), Snackbar (tinted + elevation shadow, no error). ICONS rebased onto real library status glyphs (status-icons/error|warning|success|information.svg = triangle for error, circle+marks for the rest) via a <symbol> sprite with style=fill:var(--mark) inner marks (custom props inherit through <use>) — fixes the prior hand-drawn approximations + the err/warn both-triangle bug + the undeclared circle/rect info blind-spot.
$dark-interim-2026-06-24: INTERIM dark treatment (Dave): rag ACCENTS use LIGHT values for stroke/surface in dark + icons go white — because dark rag/information aliases a MISSING color/blue/400 (illustration-palette leak #4587A7, white-on-it = 4.0:1 fail). Tints stay dark (correct). Revisit at token level — see the dark-rag-token-gaps note (also affects dark focus/ring board-wide).

accessibility.announce: Notifications must be announced to AT — use role=alert / aria-live=assertive for errors, polite for info/success; snackbars are aria-live polite and must persist long enough to read
accessibility.useOfColour: RAG variant must not rely on colour alone — pair with an icon and text (1.4.1)
accessibility.contrast: Tinted surfaces + #333 text and the solid global fills must meet contrast; warning yellow uses dark text
accessibility.dismiss: Dismissible notifications need an accessible close; snackbar auto-dismiss must not be the only path for keyboard/AT users

antiPatterns: Conveying status by colour alone (no icon/text)
Using a Snackbar for errors (use Contextual/Global) or for critical content that must persist
Auto-dismissing a snackbar too fast to read / with no accessible alternative
Leaving the Contextual RAG-badge icon on the deprecated rag/icon tokens — rebind to rag/text/on-dark (see tokenValidation)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: PASS — Global / Inline / Snackbar CLEAN (fully on rag/*); Contextual + form multi-link carry 2 deprecated rag/icon tokens (clean rebinds).

tokens.usedBy: Contextual + form multi-link error badge glyph
Contextual + form multi-link success badge glyph

depricateUsage.note: Only the Contextual family surfaced deprecated rag/icon tokens (error + success). The information badge glyph is likely also rag/icon (depricate)/information/icon and warning uses rag/text/on-light (#333) — all map cleanly to rag/text/on-dark|on-light per the replacement map. Global/Inline/Snackbar already use rag/text/* directly.

family.$note: Covers the 'Notifications' canvas: Contextual, Global, Inline, Snackbar.
